class: the review cap carries trivial fixes

class: the push gate and CI disagree on the runner
rule: A test is green only under the runner CI uses.

rule: A review judges the scope it was briefed on, so a unit whose Affects grows after the brief is judged against the wrong scope.
behaviour: Before sending a fix round to its reviewer, re-brief the unit whenever its file changed since the last brief.
